name: The Coldbringer's Eye
summary: The Kirin Tor seeks the Coldbringer’s Eye, a scrying orb used by a servant of the Lich King in Razorfen Downs. You are asked to recover it so the artifact can be studied.

sections.title: A Kirin Tor Request
sections.body: A servant of the Lich King dwells in Razorfen Downs, where the quilboar lair shelters him. The Kirin Tor says he uses the Coldbringer’s Eye to direct lesser minions elsewhere. You are asked to retrieve the orb for their study.

faq.answer: The Coldbringer’s Eye is a scrying orb used by a servant of the Lich King in Razorfen Downs.
The Kirin Tor wants the Coldbringer’s Eye so it can study the artifact and understand how it works.
The Coldbringer’s Eye is in Razorfen Downs.
A servant of the Lich King in Razorfen Downs uses the orb to direct lesser minions elsewhere.
